values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigbearpoint ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (nightly fee $20; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch within the campground (parking for 3-4 vehicles with trailers); carry-in access at the launch or directly at some campsites.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigbearpoint ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well', 'A boat launch is located within the campground ... A parking lot adjacent to the boat launch can accommodate 3-4 vehicles with trailers', 'Carry-in access is located at the boat launch or directly at some campsites'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigbearpoint ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 14 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording). No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigbearpoint ('There are 14 sites for tent and small trailer use', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (14 campsites), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Big Bear Point State Forest Campground: 'Seasonal closure dates' 'Nov 1 to April 15'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on the north shore of Big Bear Lake among evergreens, 1.75 miles southwest of Vienna Corners via Principal Meridian Road and Little Bear Lake Road; Big Bear Lake Pathway for hiking and mountain biking. Separate from the larger Big Bear Lake SFC a mile north. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 14 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch in the campground (facilities.note), first-come only, 15-day max (confirmed; max stay now on the entry). Added season Apr 15 - Oct 31 (table: closed Nov 1 - April 15). Phone differs (flag). Note trimmed; its '~$15-20' and 'April-October' dropped for the fields.
